senses.gloss:
PAUCITY:
(1) स्वल्पता;
(2) by adj.: v.
Few.

PAUNCH (subs.): पिचिण्डः: v. Belly.
Having
a p.:
पिचिण्डिल (f. ला).

PAUPERISM:
(1) दारिद्र्यम् ( poverty):
(2)
भिक्षावृत्तिः (= begging);
(3) अनाथता (= with-
-out protection).

PAUSE (subs.):
(1) विरामः (in every sense),
low at p. s:
विरामे मृदुम्, Mr. iii. 5.;
(2) यतिः
(in poetry): v. Also cessation.

PAUSE (v.): विरमति (रम्, c. 1.): v. To cease,
stop,
p. upon:
संचिन्तयति (चिन्त्, c. 10.):
v. To consider, think about.
